title: Vibe coding native mobile games from your phone
author: jfbisson4
selftext:
I've been building Backtick, a personal project that lets you make native mobile games by chatting with Claude on your phone: no code, no computer, and they run as real native apps, not web pages. The clip is a 3D island I built with it; one message ("make it sunset") changed the lighting in about 30 seconds.

What I've learned so far:

* Build incrementally: many small prompts beat one big one, and you get to feel the loop each time
* Point at things that already exist instead of describing them: "make the ball bounce like a basketball on concrete" beats "add bounciness"

If you want to try it, I'm running a free jam until Saturday: build a mobile game with Claude from your phone, and play it in Backtick. Top 3 get $150/$75/$25, and 1st gets demoed on stage at React Summit.

[https://itch.io/jam/jam-from-your-phone](https://itch.io/jam/jam-from-your-phone)
